evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, 香港中文大學
evidence.field: 形義源流通解 / 字形與分析
evidence.text: The entry describes oracle-bone and early bronze forms as 木 with small circles on branches, depicting fruit growing on a tree. It says later bronze fruit shapes came to resemble 田, a shape followed in small seal and regular script. It disputes identifying the oracle form as an early 葉 graph by comparing other plant graphs and 采.
evidence.title: 漢字甲骨部件分析：果

evidence.source: 中央研究院文字學資料庫
evidence.text: The entry lists oracle-bone, bronze, Chu bamboo and silk, small seal, and 說文 forms; the bronze listing includes 集成03474. Its explanation says 果 resembles fruit above 木. It does not give a date for the oracle form or a primary inscription image with context on this page.
evidence.title: 漢字「果」：字形演變

evidence.field: 說明 / 釋義與所引書證
evidence.text: The dictionary quotes 說文: 木實也。从木，象果形在木之上. Its lexical entry lists fruit, outcome/result, realization, fullness, decisiveness, certainty, and conditional uses, with citations including 《韓非子》, 《漢書》, 《南史》, 《韓非子·外儲說左下》, 《易經》, 《禮記·中庸》 and 《左傳》. These dictionary citations establish cited textual examples but do not by themselves prove a chronological semantic chain.
evidence.title: A01876 果 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.text: The Guangyun entry gives 古火切, 見母, 戈一合, 果攝, 上聲. It lists Middle Chinese reconstructions in named systems, including Baxter kwaX and Zhengzhang kuɑ, and a derived Mandarin guo3. Its gloss includes 果敢 and 木實.
evidence.title: 果 - 小韻 - 廣韻 - 韻典網

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, 香港中文大學
evidence.field: 形義源流通解 / 早期用法
evidence.text: The entry reports oracle-bone 果 used for 果然 and as a place name, and bronze use as a personal name. It attributes the extension from fruit to 果然, then 果敢 and 果斷, to 徐灝's account. The page does not date these individual uses or demonstrate a complete sequence.
evidence.title: 漢字甲骨部件分析：果

evidence.source: Ministry of Education 《Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary》
evidence.text: The dictionary defines 果敢 as brave and decisive and cites 《荀子·榮辱》 and 《後漢書·儒林傳下·周澤傳》. These citations support the lexical use in those texts; they do not establish when the sense first developed or whether every early graph use carries it.
evidence.title: 果敢 - Ministry of Education 《Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary》

evidence.field: 廣韻小韻 / phonetic role and 果 reading
evidence.text: The same rhyme entry separately lists 婐-like related graphs? No: its listed 果-series characters include 惈, whose gloss states that 蒼頡篇 wrote 果敢 as 惈. This supports a later graph association for 果敢, not a phonetic component analysis of 果 itself. No internal sound component is proposed for the pictographic 果 graph.
evidence.title: 果 - 小韻 - 廣韻 - 韻典網

gaps: Earliest securely dated semantic context for fruit is not established here from an inspected primary inscription in context; early graphic attestations do not alone establish the word used in that inscription.

The reported oracle-bone 果然 and place-name uses, and Zhao's separately reported 能夠 interpretation in the dossier, have disputed or insufficiently demonstrated readings and relationships. No complete dated lexical chronology is established.

The transition from fruit to outcome, completion, firmness, decisiveness, certainty and adverbial 果然 is not documented as a dated semantic chain by the inspected material. Dictionary gloss lists and quotations cannot supply that chronology alone.

CUHK describes later bronze fruit forms as becoming similar to 田 and says small seal and regular forms follow that shape. Inspected sources do not provide a full dated sequence of individual form variants or support a claim of scribal corruption.

No separately proposed phonetic component occurs in the supported pictographic account. 果 is therefore not assigned a component pronunciation comparison; its readings are reported independently in Mandarin guǒ and Middle Chinese Baxter kwaX / Zhengzhang kuɑ.

The Commons candidate is explicitly a modern vector redraw sourced to a cited character-form database, not an image of an excavated oracle-bone object. Direct SVG rendering could not be checked in the web viewer.

The Academia Sinica chardb site expressly reserves image rights; its forms are cited as evidence only, not proposed as reusable glyph assets. Xiaoxuetang query pages could not be opened in this attempt.

items.period: Shang oracle-bone script style; specific ancient object/date not identified by the asset page
items.tradition: Chinese oracle-bone script; modern digital redraw
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of an oracle-script form of 果, presented as a tree with fruit above it. It illustrates the reported graphic analysis, rather than showing an excavated inscription.
items.alt: Modern black vector outline of an early 果 graph, with a tree-like lower element and clustered marks above.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description ties this particular form to 果 and names source character J14163; CUHK independently explains the early graph as fruit on 木. The Commons page reports public-domain reuse for the redraw.
items.rights: Public domain according to the Commons file page; attribution appreciated. Digital redraw, not ancient artifact photography.

limitations.text: The direct candidate is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph, and the image viewer rejected its SVG payload; no pixel-level inspection is claimed. Its provenance and depiction label come from the inspected Commons page.
The Academia Sinica character evolution page is useful linked evidence, but its separate rights notice reserves rights over images; no image from that database is proposed for reuse.
